objective: Collect newly reported WA house sales with repeatable coverage and observation history
queryEncoding: variables.query is a JSON-encoded string, not a nested object

liveEvidence.browser: Chrome, successful existing normal site session
liveEvidence.limits: Only required listing fields and pagination were retained. Full JSON response bodies were inspected but not archived. No authentication, challenge token, cookie or tracking payload was saved.

directHttpTest.result: Challenge HTML; no listing JSON. Standalone curl collection is not proven.

collectorRecommendation.transport: Use the existing normal Chrome session and collect the site's successful listing responses. A standalone HTTP transport requires its own successful access test.
collectorRecommendation.scope: Keep the dated WA suburb plan and exact-house filters; use the observed query shape with each locality and page, then verify the resolved scope.
collectorRecommendation.coverage: Commit a page only after validating and persisting its rows. Require explicit terminal pagination, unique IDs, and reconciliation to reported totals; mark failures or source caps incomplete.
collectorRecommendation.history: Preserve dated observations separately from current sales. Listing identity must prevent repeat captures and later disclosures from creating additional sales.
collectorRecommendation.price: Retain display text. Populate numeric price only for an explicit single disclosed dollar amount; missing prices remain usable for counts.
collectorRecommendation.compatibility: Existing CSV address must be shortAddress plus suburb. The current SQL treats the final comma-separated segment as suburb, so fullAddress must not be copied into that field.
collectorRecommendation.contractStability: This is an observed site implementation endpoint, not a documented supported market-data API. The persisted hash and response shape may change. Page caps and other suburbs were not tested here.
collectorRecommendation.refreshWindow: The six-month source filter moves with time. Record each capture timestamp and apply the planned 2026-06-01 overlap cutoff locally for this run.
